svg.title: Sentinel LangGraph state machine
svg.desc: Flowchart of the Sentinel incident-response graph: entry through guardrail_input, routing/retrieval/reranking/grading with a self-RAG retry loop, diagnosis and proposed action, a second guardrail check branching into human approval or direct execution, execution with a failure loop back to diagnosis, and a final postmortem and guardrail pass to end.
